title: Gateway token files are never committed
problem: arena-manager tracks .arena/gateway_tokens.json containing exposed tokens; the pytest gateway suite recreates the file locally.

options.summary: Keep .arena/gateway_tokens.json gitignored and enforce by test that it is not tracked; exposed tokens must be rotated by the owner

rationale: Secrets never enter the repository, memory, issues, prompts or evidence. The repo-invariants test fails if the file becomes tracked. Rotation of already exposed tokens is an owner action and is recorded as an open blocker, not claimed as done.

reason.summary: Revision corrects placeholder timestamps written in PR #274 (JRN-0012): createdAt was 2026-09-25T00:00:00Z (after the PR #273 merge) and is now the authored time of the PR #273 commit (2026-09-24T23:15:25Z); promotedAt was 2026-09-25T14:00:00Z and is now the PR #274 merge time (2026-09-25T00:17:56Z). Decision content unchanged.
